item.title: Mac 与 iPhone 使用客户端证书访问 mTLS 网站
item.description:
Accessing mTLS Websites with Client Certificates on Mac and iPhone

This article documents how to use client certificates to access an internal mTLS website on macOS and iPhone. It covers CanoKey PIV, step-ca, Nginx, and installing system certificates on iOS.

1. Environment and Authentication Flow

The current environment is as follows:

  • CA: The existing CX-Homelab-CA Root CA and CX-Homelab-CA Intermediate CA.
  • Certificate issuance: step-ca.
  • Web server: Nginx 1.25.0.
  • Test site: https://www.home.arpa.
  • Mac client: CanoKey PIV 9A.
  • iPhone client: A client certificate and private key imported through a PKCS#12 file.

The difference between mTLS and ordinary HTTPS is that the server validates the client certificate, while the client must also validate the server certificate. The client certificate must contain the corresponding private key; installing a .crt file alone is generally insufficient to complete client authentication.

item.title: The History of China's Straw Burning Ban Policy: From Traditional Farming to Modern Environmental Governance
item.description:
The history of China’s straw burning ban policy is, in effect, a microcosm of the country’s agricultural modernization, rural energy transition, environmental governance, and the evolution of grassroots administrative practice.

The most important historical conclusion is this: large-scale straw burning was not a problem that existed in China throughout history, nor did the prohibition begin only in recent years. The modern straw burning ban system was gradually established in the 1990s, took the form of a nationwide management regulation in 1999, was visibly strengthened around 2008, and was further incorporated into the air pollution prevention and control system after 2013.

Why OpenList Quark WebDAV Uploads Use Excessive Memory: Causes and Optimization

When using rclone to upload local files to Quark Cloud Drive through OpenList’s WebDAV interface, OpenList’s memory usage may increase significantly, even triggering a container OOM. Investigation found that the key factors are the full-file cache used before uploads by the Quark driver and the file page cache included in container statistics.

This analysis focuses on OpenList v4.2.7, the standard Quark driver, Docker, and cgroup v2. The implementation should be rechecked for other drivers and versions.
